title: Imali nokuthenga
description: Ten short stories about money and shopping: a trader paid with a fake note, a grandmother's homemade soap, trousers spoiled in the wash, cattle bought for the bride price, a hospital bill, a holiday job on a farm, a boat trip for paying visitors, football fans in a beach bar, choosing a crèche, and a rich man who learns what his wealth is worth.

lessons.title: Imali embumbulu
lessons.summary: Street trader Thandazile in Durban is paid with a fake note; the bank-note expert Ngubane at her wholesaler shows her how to check notes in the light; the other traders whisper and criticise, but when the young man comes back she refuses his money and the police catch him.
lessons.text:
UThandazile ungumhwebi omncane eThekwini. Uthengisa izithelo nemifino etafuleni lakhe eduze komgwaqo omkhulu. Eduze kwakhe kukhona abanye abahwebi abaningi. Bonke abahwebi bayamazi uThandazile, futhi abathengi bayamthanda, ngoba izithelo zakhe zinhle.

NgoLwesihlanu insizwa egqoke kahle iphuma kulesiya sitolo esikhulu esiphesheya komgwaqo. Ifika etafuleni likaThandazile, ithenge izithelo eziningi kakhulu. Inika uThandazile iphepha lemali elikhulu. Izithelo zibiza imali encane kunaleli phepha, ngakho uThandazile uyibuyisela enye imali. Uyajabula, ngoba usuku lwakhe beluluhle.

Ngakusihlwa uThandazile uya esitolo lapho ethenga khona izithelo zakusasa. Ukhokha ngemali yosuku. Owesifazane osebenza esitolo uthatha amaphepha emali, awafake emshinini. Umshini uyakhala. Owesifazane uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, mama. Leli phepha liyimbumbulu."

UThandazile akakholwa. Owesifazane ubiza uNgubane, oyingcweti yemali kulesi sitolo. UNgubane ubheka iphepha isikhathi eside. Uthi: "Yebo, le mali imbumbulu. Imali yangempela inesithombe esibonakala uma uyibheka ekukhanyeni. Bheka leli phepha ekukhanyeni: alinaso isithombe." Uthi futhi: "Imali embumbulu ifana nemali yangempela, kodwa ingcweti iyabona ukuthi yimbumbulu."

UThandazile uyaphoxeka. Abantu abalindile ngemuva kwakhe bayambheka. Uthi: "Ngiphoxekile. Bazocabanga ukuthi ngiyisigebengu." UNgubane uthi: "Cha, mama. Awenzanga lutho olubi. Isigebengu ngumuntu okunike le mali." Ukhombisa uThandazile ukuthi angayibona kanjani imali embumbulu. Uthi: "Ungesabi ukwala imali embumbulu. Ukwala akusona isono."

Ngakusasa ekuseni kukhona amahlebezi phakathi kwabahwebi. Bathi: "UThandazile uthathe imali embumbulu." UThandazile uyawezwa amahlebezi abo. Umhwebi omdala uthi kuye: "Umhwebi ohlakaniphile uyayibheka imali ngaphambi kokuthi ayithathe." Ukugxeka kwakhe kubuhlungu. Amahlebezi nokugxeka kuyamdumaza uThandazile. Uthi: "Kuyangidumaza lokhu. Nami ngingumhwebi omuhle."

Ngemuva kwesonto insizwa iyabuya. Ifuna izithelo futhi, inike uThandazile iphepha lemali elikhulu. Manje uThandazile ubheka iphepha ekukhanyeni, njengoba uNgubane emfundisile. Alinaso isithombe. Uthi: "Ngizokwala le mali. Iyimbumbulu."

Insizwa iyabaleka, igijimele kulesiya sitolo esikhulu. Ngenhlanhla, amaphoyisa amabili ayelindile eduze kwalesiya sitolo. Abahwebi babiza amaphoyisa, futhi amaphoyisa ayibambe insizwa. Esikhwameni sayo kukhona amaphepha amaningi emali embumbulu. Ngenhlanhla, akekho omunye umhwebi oyithathile namuhla.

Umhwebi omdala uza kuThandazile. Uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa ngokugxeka kwami. Manje uyingcweti." Amahlebezi ayaphela. UThandazile akasaphoxeki, futhi akasadumazeki. Ufundisa abanye abahwebi ukubheka imali ekukhanyeni.

Imibuzo:
UThandazile wenzani eThekwini?
Ungumhwebi, uthengisa izithelo nemifino etafuleni lakhe.
Kwenzekani esitolo ngakusihlwa?
Umshini uyakhala, futhi owesifazane uthi iphepha liyimbumbulu.
UNgubane uyibona kanjani imali embumbulu?
Uyibheka ekukhanyeni, ngoba imali yangempela inesithombe esibonakalayo.
Kungani uThandazile edumazeka?
Ngoba kukhona amahlebezi nokugxeka phakathi kwabahwebi.
Kwenzekani lapho insizwa ibuya?
UThandazile uthi uzokwala imali yayo, insizwa ibaleke, amaphoyisa ayibambe.

lessons.title: Insipho kagogo
lessons.summary: Grandmother Nomfanelo in Nongoma makes soap to sell: her granddaughter Hlengekile draws water into a drum, the fat and ash boil into a mixture, perfume goes in; at the reed festival in Nyokeni the queen buys ten bars, and a Durban shop Hlengekile wrote to orders more.
lessons.text:
UGogo Nomfanelo uhlala eNongoma. Uneminyaka engamashumi ayisikhombisa, kodwa usasebenza. Wenza insipho ekhaya, bese eyithengisa. Insipho yakhe inamakha amnandi, futhi abantu abaningi bayayithanda. Umzukulu wakhe uHlengekile uyamsiza ngezikhathi zamaholide.

Ngolunye usuku ekuseni uGogo Nomfanelo noHlengekile bahamba bayokukha amanzi emfuleni. UHlengekile ukha amanzi ngesitsha, awathele emgqomeni omkhulu. Ugogo uthi: "Khetha amanzi ahlanzekile, mzukulu wami. Insipho enhle idinga amanzi amahle." UHlengekile ukha amanzi kaningi, kuze kugcwale umgqomo.

Ekhaya ugogo ubasa umlilo, abeke umgqomo phezu komlilo. Ubilisa amanzi. Lapho amanzi eqala ukubila, uthela amafutha emanzini abilayo, afake nomlotha omncane. Lokhu kuyingxubevange emnyama. Ugogo uyinyakazisa ngenduku enkulu. Uthi: "Ingxubevange kumele iqhubeke ibila isikhathi eside. Ungayeki ukuyinyakazisa." Ngakho uHlengekile uyinyakazisa ingxubevange amahora amabili, kuze ibe mhlophe. Ugogo ubilisa ingxubevange kancane, ngoba uma uyibilisa kakhulu iyasha.

Bese ugogo ufaka amakha. Usebenzisa izimbali zasendle namafutha amnandi. Uthi: "Amakha yiwo enza abantu bathenge insipho yami." Wonke umuzi unuka amakha amnandi. Ugogo uthela ingxubevange ezitsheni ezincane. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu insipho isiqinile. UHlengekile uyayibala: zingamakhulu amabili.

UHlengekile uthi: "Gogo, kungani ungathengisi insipho yakho ezitolo zaseThekwini?" Ugogo uyahleka, athi: "Angikwazi ukubhala kahle isiNgisi." UHlengekile uthi: "Mina ngiyakwazi. Ngizolobela isitolo esikhulu." Ngalobo busuku ulobela isitolo esikhulu eThekwini incwadi, abatshele ngensipho kagogo wakhe namakha ayo.

NgoSepthemba ugogo noHlengekile baya eNyokeni, lapho izinkulungwane zezintombi zihlangana khona unyaka nonyaka ngenxa yomhlanga. Izintombi zihamba ziphatha imihlanga emide, zihlabelela. Imihlanga yazo iyanyakaza emoyeni. Ugogo uthengisa insipho yakhe etafuleni eduze kwendlela. Abantu abaningi bayathenga, ngoba bayawazi amakha ayo.

Emini kufika indlovukazi. Indlovukazi ihamba kancane phakathi kwamatafula, ibingelele abantu. Ima etafuleni likagogo, ithathe insipho. Iyayinuka, ithi: "Amakha ayo amnandi kakhulu, gogo." Indlovukazi ithenga insipho eyishumi. Ugogo uyajabula kakhulu, angakholwa.

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili isitolo saseThekwini simlobela uHlengekile. Sithi: "Sicela usithumelele insipho engamakhulu amathathu." Ugogo uthi kuHlengekile: "Yonke le nhlanhla ivela encwadini yakho."

Imibuzo:
UGogo Nomfanelo noHlengekile bayokukha amanzi kuphi?
Bayokukha amanzi emfuleni, bawathele emgqomeni omkhulu.
Ugogo wenzani ngamanzi abilayo?
Uthela amafutha nomlotha emanzini abilayo, enze ingxubevange.
Kungani abantu bethanda insipho kagogo?
Ngoba inamakha amnandi.
Izintombi ziphatha imihlanga enjani eNyokeni?
Ziphatha imihlanga emide.
Ubani othenga insipho eyishumi?
Indlovukazi ithenga insipho eyishumi.

lessons.title: Ibhulukwe elimpunga
lessons.summary: With his first pay Samkelo in Pretoria chooses grey cotton trousers and a cheap red jacket instead of a dear coat; he soaks them together in hot water, the colours run, the brush does not help, and his mother shows him how to wash cotton apart and soften it.
lessons.text:
USamkelo uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Uqale umsebenzi omusha ehhovisi ePitoli, futhi namuhla uthole imali yakhe yokuqala. Ufuna ukuthenga izingubo ezintsha zomsebenzi. Umama wakhe uthi: "Ungayimoshi imali yakho, mntwana wami. Thenga izingubo ezinhle eziqinile kuphela."

USamkelo uya esitolo sezingubo edolobheni. Isisebenzi sesitolo siyamsiza. Simkhombisa amabhulukwe amaningi: amnyama, aluhlaza, ampunga. USamkelo uqoma ibhulukwe elimpunga lokotini. Isisebenzi sithi: "Lo kotini muhle futhi uqinile. Kodwa uma ulimosha ibhulukwe ngokuligeza kabi, ngeke libe lihle futhi."

Bese uSamkelo ubona ijazi elide elimpunga. Ijazi lihle kakhulu, kodwa liyabiza. Ucabanga ngamazwi kamama wakhe, athi: "Ngeke ngiyimoshe imali yami ngejazi namuhla. Ebusika ngizothenga ijazi." Esikhundleni sejazi uqoma ibhantshi elincane elibomvu lokotini. Ibhantshi alibizi kakhulu.

NgoMgqibelo uSamkelo ufuna ukugeza izingubo zakhe ezintsha ngaphambi kokuthi azigqoke. Ugcwalisa isitsha ngamanzi ashisayo, afake insipho. Ucwilisa ibhulukwe elimpunga nebhantshi elibomvu ndawonye. Ucabanga ukuthi ukucwilisa kuzosiza ukuthi kuphume uthuli lwesitolo. Uyahamba, abuke ibhola kumabonakude amahora amabili.

Lapho ebuya, uSamkelo uyamangala. Amanzi abomvu. Ibhulukwe lakhe elimpunga manje libomvu kancane, ngoba imibala ixubene emanzini ashisayo. Ugeza ibhulukwe ngebhulashi ngamandla. Kodwa umbala obomvu awuphumi. Ibhulashi alisizi lutho.

USamkelo uya kumama wakhe ephethe ibhulukwe. Umama uyahleka, athi: "Mntwana wami, umoshile imali yakho. Ungacwilisi izingubo ezibomvu nezingubo ezimpunga ndawonye. Imibala iyaxubana, ikakhulukazi emanzini ashisayo. Imibala ixubana kalula engubeni yokotini." Uthi futhi: "Kodwa ungakhali. Ngizokufundisa."

Ngenyanga elandelayo uSamkelo uthenga elinye ibhulukwe elimpunga. Umama umfundisa ukuligeza lodwa, emanzini angashisi, ngensipho encane. Ngemuva kwalokho uthela into yokuthambisa emanzini. Umama uthi: "Le nto ithambisa ukotini. Ukuthambisa kwenza ukuthi ibhulukwe libe lithambile futhi lihlale isikhathi eside." USamkelo ulibeka elangeni ukuze lome.

NgoMsombuluko uSamkelo uya emsebenzini egqoke ibhulukwe lakhe elimpunga. Lithambile, futhi limpunga ngempela. Ibhulukwe elibomvu kancane ulinika umzala wakhe omncane, olithandayo kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
USamkelo uqoma ibhulukwe elinjani esitolo?
Uqoma ibhulukwe elimpunga lokotini.
Kungani engathengi ijazi?
Ngoba ijazi liyabiza, futhi akafuni ukumosha imali yakhe.
Kwenzekani lapho ecwilisa ibhulukwe nebhantshi elibomvu ndawonye?
Imibala iyaxubana, futhi ibhulukwe liba bomvu kancane.
Ibhulashi liyamsiza na?
Cha, umbala obomvu awuphumi.
Into yokuthambisa yenzani?
Ithambisa ukotini, futhi ibhulukwe lihlale isikhathi eside.

lessons.title: Ilobolo likaVuyisile
lessons.summary: Vuyisile, who works in Johannesburg, wants to pay the bride price for Senamile in real cattle; an invitation says her family members are ready and her father wants a black ox; his cattle-wise nephew Lwazelo helps him buy cows and the ox and herds them, the cows are milked and go out to graze, and meat is roasted.
lessons.text:
UVuyisile usebenza eGoli, kodwa umndeni wakhe uhlala eMpofana. Uthanda intombi egama layo nguSenamile. Iminyaka emithathu uVuyisile wagcina imali, ngoba ufuna ukulobola ngezinkomo zangempela, hhayi ngemali kuphela.

Ngolunye usuku ubaba wakhe uyamshayela ucingo. Uthi: "Mfana wami, kufike isimemo esivela emzini kaSenamile. Umkhaya wakhe ulungele ukwamukela izinkomo zakho ngoMgqibelo. Unyoko uyajabula kakhulu. Unyoko uthi ungakhohlwa inzima." UVuyisile uyahleka. Uthi: "Baba, ngicela utshele unyoko ukuthi angikhohlwa lutho."

Isimemo sithi ubaba kaSenamile ufuna izinkomo ezinhlanu, futhi enye yazo kumele ibe yinzima, inkabi emnyama. Ubaba kaSenamile wayehlale ethanda inzima, ngoba ubaba wakhe naye wayenayo. Umkhaya kaSenamile ugcina amasiko amadala.

NgoLwesine uVuyisile ufika eMpofana. Ngakusasa uhamba nomshana wakhe uLwazelo, baye endaweni lapho abalimi bedayisa khona izinkomo. ULwazelo uneminyaka eyishumi nesihlanu, futhi uyazazi izinkomo, ngoba welusa izinkomo zomkhulu wakhe nsuku zonke. Umshana uthi: "Malume, ungathengi le nkomo. Ayinamandla." UVuyisile uyamlalela umshana wakhe. Bathenga izinkomo ezine ezinhle, nenzima enkulu emnyama kakhulu. Inzima ibiza kakhulu, kodwa uVuyisile uyakhokha.

ULwazelo welusa izinkomo, azihambise ekhaya ngomgwaqo omude. Ngalobo busuku izinkomo zilala esibayeni sikayise kaVuyisile.

NgoMgqibelo uVuyisile uvuka ngaphambi kwelanga. Umama wakhe usesibayeni, usenga izinkomo zakhe. Usenga ngokushesha, futhi ubisi lugcwala izitsha. Ngemuva kokusenga, izinkomo zabo ziyeluka. Zeluka ensimini eluhlaza eduze komfula, zibuyele ekhaya kusihlwa. Kodwa izinkomo zelobolo azeluki namuhla. Zizohamba nomkhaya kaVuyisile ziye emzini kaSenamile.

Emini abomkhaya kaVuyisile bafika emzini kaSenamile. ULwazelo welusa izinkomo ngaphambi kwabo, inzima ihamba phambili. Abomkhaya kaSenamile bayajabula kakhulu. Ubaba kaSenamile ubheka inzima isikhathi eside, athi: "Lo ngumkhwenyana wami. Ulobole kahle."

Ngemuva kwalokho abesilisa bosa inyama emlilweni eduze kwesibaya. Ukosa inyama kuthatha amahora amabili, futhi wonke umuzi unuka inyama. Abomkhaya bonke bayadla, bayahlabelela, bayadansa. USenamile uhlezi nomama kaVuyisile, baxoxa futhi bayahleka.

Imibuzo:
Isimemo esivela emzini kaSenamile sithini?
Sithi umkhaya kaSenamile ulungele ukwamukela izinkomo, futhi ubaba kaSenamile ufuna inzima.
Kungani uVuyisile elalela umshana wakhe uLwazelo?
Ngoba uLwazelo uyazazi izinkomo, ngoba welusa izinkomo zomkhulu wakhe nsuku zonke.
Kwenzekani esibayeni ngoMgqibelo ekuseni?
Umama kaVuyisile usenga izinkomo, bese izinkomo zabo ziyeluka.
Ubaba kaSenamile uthini lapho ebona inzima?
Uthi uVuyisile ulobole kahle.
Abesilisa benzani ngemuva kwalokho?
Bosa inyama emlilweni eduze kwesibaya.

lessons.title: Itshe ensweni
lessons.summary: Bus driver Nkosiyabo thinks he does not need health insurance until pain from his back to his testicle, painful urination and a faint at work take him to hospital; Dr Hadebe finds the gallbladder healthy and a stone in the kidney, medicine eases the pain, and the bill makes him buy insurance.
lessons.text:
UNkosiyabo uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu. Ushayela ibhasi eThekwini. Akanawo umshwalense wezempilo, ngoba uthi uyabiza kakhulu. Uthi: "Mina ngiphilile. Angiyidingi leyo mali."

NgoLwesibili ebusuku uNkosiyabo uvuka nobuhlungu obukhulu emhlane. Ubuhlungu buqala emhlane, behle buye esiswini nasesendeni. Uya endlini yokugezela. Ukuchama kubuhlungu kakhulu, futhi kunegazi. Uchama kancane kuphela. Akakwazi ukulala.

Ekuseni uNkosiyabo uya emsebenzini, ngoba akafuni ukulahlekelwa yimali yosuku. Kodwa lapho eqala ukushayela, ubuhlungu buba bukhulu kakhulu. Ubona umnyama emehlweni. Uyaquleka eduze kwebhasi. Abantu bayagijima, bamlalise phansi. Lapho evula amehlo, umnyama uyaphela. Uthi: "Ngiqulekile ngoba ubuhlungu bukhulu." Abasebenzi bebhasi bamhambisa esibhedlela esiseduze.

Esibhedlela owesifazane osebenza lapho ufaka into yokulinganisa ukushisa ekhwapheni lakhe. Ubeka ingalo yakhe phansi, athi: "Gcina ingalo yakho iqinile, ukuze into ihlale ekhwapheni lakho." Ngemuva kwalokho ufaka umuthi emkhonweni wakhe. Umkhono wakhe ubuhlungu kancane.

Kufika udokotela uHadebe. Ucela uNkosiyabo ukuthi akhumule zonke izingubo. UNkosiyabo ulala embhedeni enqunu, embozwe ngengubo emhlophe. Akajwayele ukuba nqunu lapho kukhona umuntu angamazi. Udokotela uthi: "Ungaphoxeki. Lapha sibona abantu abanqunu nsuku zonke."

UHadebe uhlola isisu sakhe ngomshini wezithombe. Uqala ngenyongo. Uthi: "Inyongo yakho iphilile. Inkinga ayikho enyongweni." Bese ehlola izinso. Uthi: "Bheka, kukhona itshe elincane ensweni yakho. Leli tshe lenza ubuhlungu emhlane nasesendeni. Futhi yilo elenza ukuthi uchame igazi."

UHadebe unika uNkosiyabo umuthi othulisa ubuhlungu. Ngemuva kwehora umuthi uyabuthulisa ubuhlungu, futhi uNkosiyabo uyalala. Ukuthulisa ubuhlungu kuyamsiza kakhulu. Lapho evuka, udokotela uthi: "Itshe lincane. Uma uphuza amanzi amaningi, lizophuma lapho uchama. Phuza amanzi amaningi nsuku zonke, ukuze izinso zakho ziphile."

Ekugcineni kufika incwadi yemali. UNkosiyabo uyibheka isikhathi eside. Kumele akhokhe imali eningi kakhulu, cishe imali yakhe yenyanga yonke. Uyakhokha ngemali ayeyigcinele umndeni wakhe. Uthi: "Ngangithi angiwudingi umshwalense. Ngangiphosisile."

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili itshe liyaphuma. Ubuhlungu buyaphela. UNkosiyabo uya ehhovisi lomshwalense, athenge umshwalense wezempilo. Manje uphuza amanzi amaningi nsuku zonke, futhi ubaxwayisa abangane bakhe: "Ningalindi ukuquleka. Thengani umshwalense manje."

Imibuzo:
UNkosiyabo uzwa ubuhlungu kuphi ebusuku?
Ubuhlungu buqala emhlane, behle buye esiswini nasesendeni.
Kwenzekani lapho eqala ukushayela?
Ubona umnyama emehlweni, bese equleka eduze kwebhasi.
Udokotela uthola inkinga enyongweni na?
Cha, ngoba inyongo yakhe iphilile.
Itshe likuphi?
Itshe lisensweni yakhe.
Kungani uNkosiyabo ethenga umshwalense ekugcineni?
Ngoba kwadingeka akhokhe imali eningi esibhedlela, cishe imali yenyanga yonke.

lessons.title: Umsebenzi epulazini
lessons.summary: Zodumo near Mkhondo needs money for his studies and works a week for the Afrikaner farmer Hendrik: he weeds, digs fence holes, fells trees and peels the poles, with resin sticking to his hands; Hendrik forbids him to cut down his father's old wild olive, where a dove has its nest, and pays him extra.
lessons.text:
UZodumo uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili. Uhlala eduze kwaseMkhondo. Ufuna ukuqhubeka nezifundo ngonyaka ozayo, kodwa umndeni wakhe awunayo imali eyanele. Ngakho ufuna umsebenzi wamaholide.

Eduze komuzi wabo kukhona ipulazi elikhulu. Umlimi walo uyibhunu, igama lakhe nguHendrik. Leli bhunu likhuluma isiZulu kahle, ngoba lakhulela epulazini phakathi kwabantu abangamaZulu. UZodumo uya kulo, athi: "Ngicela umsebenzi, baba. Ngifuna imali yesikole." UHendrik uthi: "Kulungile. Ngizokukhokhela ngesonto lonke. Kodwa umsebenzi unzima."

NgoMsombuluko uZodumo uhlakula insimu yemifino. Uhlakula kusukela ekuseni kuze kube semini. Ilanga liyashisa. UHendrik uthi: "Ukuhlakula kahle kusiza imifino ukuthi ikhule." Ngakusihlwa insimu ihlanzekile.

NgoLwesibili nangoLwesithathu uZodumo wemba imigodi yothango olusha. Umsebenzi wokumba unzima, ngoba umhlaba uqinile futhi unamatshe. Wemba umgodi ngamunye ngefosholo, aze afike ekujuleni okufanele. Ngakusihlwa izandla zakhe zibuhlungu, kodwa imigodi engamashumi amathathu isilungile.

NgoLwesine uHendrik uthatha uZodumo amhambise ehlathini elincane. Uthi: "Lezi zihlahla zindala. Sizozigawula, sizenze izigxobo zothango." UZodumo ugawula isihlahla ngembazo. Ukugawula kudinga amandla amaningi. UHendrik uthi: "Manje ebula izigxobo." UZodumo uyazebula, akhiphe isikhumba sazo ngommese. Ukwebula kuyamsiza ukuthi izigxobo zome kahle. Inhlaka yezihlahla inamathela ezandleni zakhe. Ugeza izandla ngensipho, kodwa inhlaka ayiphumi kalula.

Phakathi kwehlathi kukhona umnqumo omdala kakhulu. Ijuba elimpunga lihlezi phezu kwawo, futhi kukhona isidleke esinamaqanda amabili. UZodumo uthatha imbazo, ufuna ukugawula umnqumo. Kodwa uHendrik uyamnqabela. Uthi: "Cha, ngane yami. Ngiyakunqabela ukugawula lo mnqumo. Ubaba wami wawutshala. Futhi ijuba linesidleke kuwo." UZodumo ubeka phansi imbazo. Ubheka ijuba elihlezi esidlekeni. Uyamangala ukuthi ibhunu linomusa kakhulu.

NgoLwesihlanu uZodumo noHendrik bafaka izigxobo emigodini. Uthango olusha luqinile. UHendrik unika uZodumo imali yesonto lonke. Umnika nemali encane eyengeziwe, athi: "Le mali eyengeziwe ngeyomnqumo wobaba nejuba." UZodumo uyahleka.

Ngakusihlwa uZodumo uxoxela umama wakhe. Uthi: "Ibhunu lingumuntu olungile. Ngizobuyela ngisebenze lapho ngamaholide alandelayo."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uZodumo efuna umsebenzi?
Ngoba ufuna imali yokuqhubeka nezifundo.
Wenzani ngoMsombuluko?
Uhlakula insimu yemifino.
Kungani umsebenzi wokumba imigodi unzima?
Ngoba umhlaba uqinile futhi unamatshe.
Kwenzekani ezandleni zakhe lapho egawula izihlahla?
Inhlaka yezihlahla inamathela ezandleni zakhe.
Kungani uHendrik emnqabela ukugawula umnqumo?
Ngoba ubaba wakhe wawutshala, futhi ijuba linesidleke kuwo.

lessons.title: Isikebhe emfuleni
lessons.summary: Lethukuthula takes paying visitors by boat on the Mfolozi as spring begins: a freezing morning, a lorry raising dust, footsteps in the tall grass and buck running out, a fish eagle; the propeller breaks in the grass, hail falls, but the visitors pay in full and he buys a new propeller.
lessons.text:
ULethukuthula unesikebhe esincane emfuleni iMfolozi. Uthatha abavakashi, ababonise izilwane nezinyoni zomfula. Abavakashi bonke bakhokha imali, futhi ngale mali uLethukuthula wondla umndeni wakhe. Ebusika abavakashi bambalwa, kodwa ekwethwaseni kwentwasahlobo bayabuya.

Ngolunye usuku ekwethwaseni kwentwasahlobo kufika abavakashi ababili abavela eLondon. Ekuseni kakhulu kuyaqanda. Abavakashi bagqoke amajazi amakhulu, kodwa bathi: "Kuyaqanda lapha! Besithi lapha kuhlala kushisa!" ULethukuthula uyahleka, athi: "Ekuseni kuyaqanda, kodwa emini kuzoshisa."

ULethukuthula uthatha abavakashi ngemoto yakhe, baye emfuleni ngomgwaqo wothuli. Iloli elikhulu liyadlula, liquba. Uthuli lugcwala yonke indawo. Abavakashi bayakhwehlela. ULethukuthula uthi: "Lawa maloli ayaquba nsuku zonke. Uma imoto iquba kanje, vala umlomo wakho."

Emfuleni bagibela isikebhe. ULethukuthula uvula umshini wesikebhe, futhi uphephela uyazungeza emanzini. Isikebhe sihamba kancane emanzini. Ngasemfuleni kukhona isikhotha eside. Bese bezwa isigqi esikhotheni. Isigqi siya siba sikhulu. Bese izinyamazane ezintathu ziphuma esikhotheni, zigijime zingene emanzini amancane. Abavakashi bayamangala. ULethukuthula uthi: "Lezi zinyamazane zifika lapha ukuze ziphuze. Isikhotha sizifihla ezilwaneni ezidla inyama."

Phezu kwesihlahla esiseduze kuhlezi ukhozi. Ukhozi luyakhala ngezwi elikhulu, luhlasele emanzini, luphume nenhlanzi. Abavakashi bathatha izithombe eziningi. Bathi: "Ukhozi luhle kakhulu!"

Ngemuva kwehora isikebhe singena endaweni enotshani obuningi emanzini. Uphephela uyabambeka otshanini, futhi umshini awusasebenzi. ULethukuthula ufaka isandla emanzini, akhiphe utshani. Kodwa uphephela wephukile. Isikebhe ngeke sihambe ngomshini manje.

Bese izulu liba mnyama, futhi isichotho siyana. Isichotho sincane, kodwa siyashaya kakhulu. Abavakashi bafihla amakhanda abo ngaphansi kwamajazi. ULethukuthula usebenzisa izinduku ezinde, aqhube isikebhe aze afike ekhaya. Isichotho siyaphela.

ULethukuthula uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa. Ngizonibuyisela ingxenye yemali yenu." Kodwa abavakashi bathi: "Cha! Sibone izinyamazane, ukhozi nesichotho. Lolu hambo beluhle kakhulu." Bamkhokhela yonke imali. Ngakusasa uLethukuthula uthenga uphephela omusha ngale mali.

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani ekwethwaseni kwentwasahlobo?
Abavakashi bayabuya emfuleni.
Kungani abavakashi bethi kuyaqanda?
Ngoba ekuseni kakhulu kuyaqanda, nakuba bebecabanga ukuthi lapha kuhlala kushisa.
Bezwani esikhotheni?
Bezwa isigqi, bese izinyamazane ezintathu ziphuma esikhotheni.
Uphephela uyabambeka kuphi?
Uyabambeka otshanini emanzini, futhi wephuka.
Abavakashi bayayifuna imali yabo na?
Cha, bakhokha yonke imali, ngoba uhambo lwalumnandi.

lessons.title: Ibhola ebha
lessons.summary: Football fans Mlungiseleli and Sibiya watch a match in a beach bar on a small budget; the fans sing their team songs, a drinker sets the two sides against each other, a punch hits Sibiya on the jaw, Mlungiseleli makes them stand back, and the bar owner calls it bravery and gives them free beer.
lessons.text:
UMlungiseleli nomngane wakhe uSibiya bayizihlwele zeqembu lebhola laseThekwini. Njalo ngoMgqibelo babuka umdlalo ebha encane esebhishi. Ibha igcwala izihlwele, futhi umoya wolwandle uyangena ngeminyango evulekile.

NgoMgqibelo uMlungiseleli unemali encane. Uthi kuSibiya: "Ngizophuza ubhiya obubili kuphela namuhla. Imali yami kumele ingapheli ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga." USibiya uyavuma. Ibha iyabiza, kodwa umdlalo mkhulu: iqembu labo lidlala neqembu laseGoli.

Umdlalo uyaqala. Izihlwele zeqembu laseThekwini zihlabelela ihubo leqembu. Ihubo lidala, futhi bonke bayalazi. Izihlwele zeqembu laseGoli nazo zihlabelela ihubo lazo. Umsindo mkhulu ebha.

Ebha kukhona indoda eyodwa ephuza kakhulu. Ayihlabeleli ihubo, kodwa iyakhuluma kakhulu. Iya ezihlweleni zaseGoli, ithi: "Izihlwele zaseThekwini zithi nina anazi lutho ngebhola." Bese iya ezihlweleni zaseThekwini, ithi: "Abantu baseGoli bathi nina ningamagwala." Le ndoda iyabaqhatha. UMlungiseleli uthi kuSibiya: "Bheka le ndoda. Iqhatha abantu ukuze balwe."

Ngemuva kwegoli lokuqala, izihlwele ziyathukuthela. Indoda yaseGoli isukuma, ishaye umuntu waseThekwini ngesibhakela. Abanye abantu baqala ukulwa. Izihlalo ziyawa. USibiya uzama ukusiza, kodwa isibhakela simshaya emhlathini. Uyawa, abambe umhlathi wakhe.

UMlungiseleli akabaleki. Umi phakathi kwezihlwele ezimbili, aphakamise izandla. Uthi ngezwi elikhulu: "Qhelani! Qhelani nonke! Ngicela niqhele!" Abantu bayamangala, baqhele kancane. UMlungiseleli uthi: "Asizile lapha ukulwa. Sizobuka ibhola. Lo muntu uyaniqhatha, futhi niyamlalela." Ukhomba indoda eqhathayo. Izihlwele ziyayibona ukuthi uMlungiseleli uqinisile. Ukulwa kuyaphela.

UMaZungu, umama onebha, ukhuluma nendoda eqhathayo. Uthi: "Uqhathe abantu, futhi izihlalo zami zephukile. Uzokhokha izihlalo, uphume ebha lami." Indoda iyakhokha, iphume. UMaZungu unika uSibiya iqhwa lomhlathi, anike uMlungiseleli nabangane bakhe ubhiya mahhala. Uthi: "Lokhu kungubuqhawe. Abantu abaningi bayabaleka uma kuqala ukulwa." USibiya uthi: "Ubuqhawe bakho bungisize kakhulu, mngane wami."

Iqembu laseThekwini liyanqoba. Ngemuva komdlalo uMlungiseleli noSibiya bahamba ebhishi, bahlabelela ihubo leqembu. Bahamba kancane ngoba umhlathi kaSibiya ubuhlungu. Imali kaMlungiseleli ayiphelanga, ngoba ubhiya bebumahhala.

Imibuzo:
UMlungiseleli noSibiya babuka umdlalo kuphi?
Babuka umdlalo ebha encane esebhishi.
Indoda ephuza kakhulu yenzani?
Iyabaqhatha abantu, ukuze izihlwele zilwe.
Kwenzekani kuSibiya?
Isibhakela simshaya emhlathini, awe phansi.
UMlungiseleli uthini lapho abantu belwa?
Uthi: "Qhelani!" futhi uthi asizile lapha ukulwa.
Kungani uMaZungu ethi lokhu kungubuqhawe?
Ngoba abantu abaningi bayabaleka uma kuqala ukulwa, kodwa uMlungiseleli akabalekanga.

lessons.title: Inkulisa yezitini
lessons.summary: Sithabile in KwaMashu compares two crèches, turns down a tiny room and saves to pay for a brick crèche with new paint and cocoa in the morning; the teacher seats her left-handed daughter on the left side of the table, a rooster struts in the yard, and the girl gives a chameleon a name.
lessons.text:
USithabile uhlala eKwaMashu nendodakazi yakhe uNtombifikile, oneminyaka emithathu. USithabile usebenza esitolo, ngakho udinga inkulisa enhle ezonakekela ingane yakhe emini. Kodwa izinkulisa ziyabiza, futhi imali yakhe incane.

NgoMgqibelo uSithabile uvakashela izinkulisa ezimbili. Inkulisa yokuqala iseduze nekhaya. Ayibizi, kodwa isemjondolweni omncane. Ubuncane begumbi buyamkhathaza uSithabile. Ucabanga: "Ubuncane balo gumbi abukuhle. Izingane azinandawo yokudlala."

Inkulisa yesibili ikude kancane. Yakhiwe ngezitini ezibomvu, futhi izitini zayo ziqinile. Ngaphakathi izindonga zipendwe ngopende oluhlaza nopende omhlophe. Upende umusha, futhi igumbi likhanya kahle. Umfundisi wenkulisa, uMazibuko, uthi: "Lapha izingane ziyadlala, ziyafunda, futhi ziyadla kahle. Ekuseni ziphuza ukhokho nobisi." Kodwa le nkulisa iyabiza kakhulu kunenkulisa yokuqala.

Ngalobo busuku uSithabile ubala imali yakhe. Unquma ukungathengi izingubo ezintsha nokungagibeli ibhasi. Uthi: "Ngizohamba ngezinyawo, kodwa ingane yami izoba sendaweni enhle." Ngakho ubhalisa uNtombifikile enkulisa yezitini.

Ngosuku lokuqala, uMazibuko ubona ukuthi uNtombifikile udweba ngesandla sobunxele. Uthi kuSithabile: "Ingane yakho inobunxele." USithabile uthi: "Yebo. Kusukela ebuncaneni bakhe usebenzisa isandla sobunxele. Kuyinkinga na?" UMazibuko uyahleka kancane. Uthi: "Cha. Ubunxele abuyona inkinga. Ngizomhlalisa ohlangothini lwesokunxele etafuleni, ukuze ingalo yakhe ingashayisani nezingalo zezinye izingane." Ngakho uNtombifikile uhlala kwesokunxele, edweba ngesandla sakhe sobunxele. Ingane ehlezi esokunxele ayishayisani nomuntu.

Emini izingane ziphuza ukhokho ofudumele egcekeni. Egcekeni lenkulisa kukhona izinkukhu ezimbalwa neqhude elikhulu elibomvu. Iqhude liyakhala, futhi izingane ziyahleka. Iqhude lihamba kancane phakathi kwezingane, lifuna isinkwa.

Ngemuva kwalokho uNtombifikile ubona unwabu esihlahleni esincane. Unwabu luluhlaza, kodwa lapho luhamba odongeni lwezitini, umbala walo uyashintsha. Izingane zifuna ukunika unwabu igama. UMazibuko uthi: "Ntombifikile, nguwe owalubona kuqala. Namuhla nguwe ozolunika igama." UNtombifikile unika unwabu igama elithi Luhlaza.

Ngakusihlwa uSithabile uyafika. UNtombifikile umbonisa iqhude, unwabu nopende omusha wezindonga. Uthi: "Mama, ngiyithanda inkulisa yami." USithabile uyajabula. Uyazi ukuthi imali yakhe ayimoshekanga.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uSithabile engayithandi inkulisa yokuqala?
Ngoba ubuncane begumbi buyamkhathaza, futhi izingane azinandawo yokudlala.
Inkulisa yesibili yakhiwe ngani?
Yakhiwe ngezitini ezibomvu, futhi ipendwe ngopende omusha.
Izingane ziphuzani ekuseni?
Ziphuza ukhokho nobisi.
Kungani uNtombifikile ehlala kwesokunxele etafuleni?
Ngoba unobunxele, futhi ingalo yakhe akufanele ishayisane nezingalo zezinye izingane.
UNtombifikile unika unwabu liphi igama?
Ulunika igama elithi Luhlaza.

lessons.title: Umcebo kaMkhwanazi
lessons.summary: Rich Johannesburg factory owner Mkhwanazi, for whom money is an idol, forces his workers to work on Sundays; when his mother dies he goes home to Nquthu, broods by her grave beside the ancestors' graves, feels pity on hearing her words, rests at ease for a week, and ends the forced Sunday work.
lessons.text:
UMkhwanazi unemboni enkulu yezingubo eGoli. Wazalelwa eNquthu, kodwa uhlale eGoli iminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Unomcebo omkhulu: izindlu ezintathu, izimoto ezine nemali eningi kakhulu. Kodwa abantu abamaziyo bathi imali iyisithixo sakhe. Bathi: "UMkhwanazi akakhonzi uNkulunkulu. Isithixo sakhe yimali."

Isonto lonke uMkhwanazi usebenza kusukela ekuseni kuze kube sebusuku. Nabasebenzi bakhe kumele basebenze ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto. Uma umuntu engafuni, uthi: "Uma ungafuni ukusebenza ngeSonto, hamba. Abanye abantu abaningi bafuna umsebenzi wakho." Abasebenzi bakhe bayamesaba. Bathi ukuphoqa kwakhe kubenza babe sengathi basebugqilini. Indodana yakhe uNdabenhle ithi: "Baba, ukuphoqa abantu akulungile. Lo msebenzi ufana nobugqila." Kodwa uMkhwanazi akalaleli.

Ngolunye usuku uMkhwanazi uthola ucingo oluvela eNquthu. Umama wakhe ushonile. UMkhwanazi ugoduka ngemoto yakhe enkulu. Uhambo lude, futhi endleleni uyabalisa. Ucabanga ngomama wakhe. Iminyaka eminingi akagodukanga, ngoba wayehlale esebenza. Wayethumela imali kuphela.

ENquthu kukhona umngcwabo omkhulu. Abomndeni bangcwaba umama kaMkhwanazi eduze kwamangcwaba abaphansi, lapho kulele khona ubaba wakhe nogogo wakhe. UMkhwanazi umi eduze kwengcwaba likamama wakhe isikhathi eside. Uyabalisa. Izinkumbulo zakhe zibuya: umama wakhe emnika ukudla, emfundisa ukufunda, emculela izingoma ebusuku. Le nkumbulo imenza akhale.

Umakhelwane omdala, uGogo Nxumalo, uza kuye. Uthi: "Mntwana wami, unyoko wayekuthanda kakhulu. Kodwa wayethi umsebenzi wakho ufana nobugqila. Wayethi: 'Ingane yami iyisigqila semali. Ayigoduki.'" UMkhwanazi uzwa umunyu omkhulu. Unomunyu ngomama wakhe, ngoba wayehlala yedwa, futhi unomunyu ngabasebenzi bakhe abangababoni abantwana babo ngeSonto. Uthi: "Gogo, uqinisile. Ngimoshe iminyaka eminingi."

UMkhwanazi uhlala eNquthu isonto lonke. Ulala endlini kamama wakhe, adle ukudla kwasemaphandleni, ahambe phakathi kwezinkomo. Ngakusihlwa uhlala otshanini enabile, abuke izintaba. Ekhaya uyenaba, futhi ukhululekile okokuqala eminyakeni eminingi. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga kubaphansi. Abaphansi bayangibona. Bayangibiza ukuthi ngigoduke njalo."

Lapho ebuyela eGoli, uMkhwanazi ubiza bonke abasebenzi bakhe. Uthi: "Kusukela namuhla, akekho ozosebenza ngeSonto. Ukuphoqa kuphelile. Nami ngizogoduka njalo enyangeni." Abasebenzi bayamangala, bajabule. UNdabenhle uthi: "Baba, manje umcebo wakho wangempela ngumndeni wakho nabantu bakho." UMkhwanazi uyavuma, athi: "Yebo. Umcebo awusona isithixo."

Imibuzo:
Abantu bathini ngoMkhwanazi nemali?
Bathi imali iyisithixo sakhe.
Kungani abasebenzi bakhe bethi basebugqilini?
Ngoba uyabaphoqa ukuthi basebenze ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto.
Kwenzekani lapho uMkhwanazi emi eduze kwengcwaba likamama wakhe?
Uyabalisa, futhi izinkumbulo zakhe zibuya.
UGogo Nxumalo uthi umama kaMkhwanazi wayekhuluma kanjani ngomsebenzi wakhe?
Wayethi umsebenzi kaMkhwanazi ufana nobugqila, futhi akagoduki.
UMkhwanazi wenzani ekhaya eNquthu ngakusihlwa?
Uhlala otshanini enabile, abuke izintaba.
